style: Flat 2D side view illustration from a children's picture book about Ice Age animals. {subject}, the whole animal visible, cute and friendly with a happy face, isolated and centered on a solid uniform pure chroma-key magenta (#FF00FF) background. No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only. Every colour has a second, slightly darker flat shade on its lower or shadow side, giving a simple two-tone shading. Clean simple shapes. No pink, purple or magenta anywhere on the animal. No text, no snow, no ground, no grass, no shadow, no scenery.
